title: SharePoint Document Retrieval
query: Find the workplace policy document in our SharePoint site.
expected_behavior: Must query SharePoint data store, locate relevant policy document, and return grounded summary with source citation.
semantic_contract: The response must locate and present actual workplace policy documents or links from SharePoint. It must NOT be a refusal message, an error, or a setup/configuration guide explaining how to connect SharePoint.

title: Deep Research Multi-Step Plan & Synthesis
expected_behavior: Must trigger Deep Research Agent via agentsSpec, generate structured Research Plan and research questions accordions, and emit session token.
semantic_contract: The response must contain a structured multi-step Deep Research plan outlining project management methodologies (such as Agile, Waterfall, Scrum, Kanban, or Hybrid approaches).

title: Gemini Notebook Knowledge Base Q&A
query: What is Model Armor's overarching purpose and operational approach to AI protection?
expected_behavior: Must query Gemini Notebook directly without external data stores, returning grounded explanation of Model Armor security policies and proactive screening.
semantic_contract: The response must clearly explain Model Armor's purpose (generative AI safety and security guardrails) and operational approach (dual-sided input/output filtering, DLP, and policy enforcement) grounded in notebook knowledge.

title: Public Google Search Web Grounding
query: What are the latest announced Google Cloud Singapore regional capabilities this year?
expected_behavior: Must invoke Google Search web grounding spec and provide real-time facts with clickable web citations.
semantic_contract: The response must provide specific, factual regional capabilities announced for Google Cloud Singapore (such as data residency, model availability, or regional ML processing) with factual citations.
